abilities.description: Can spot forgery and hidden debts in air accounts at a glance.
abilities.name: Breath-Ledger Reckoning

abilities.description: Knows how to coax and interpret stored testimony from the light-creatures in stained glass.
abilities.name: Glass Reading

characters.arc: She begins as a cautious clerk guarding her own advantage, learns that the truth about the bell must be shared, and ends by publicly staking her own breath-standing on exposing the secret, choosing communal survival over private security.
characters.description: A former glass-guild tallykeeper in her late twenties, Iselda grew up in the narrow lanes beside the Nave Concourse, where she learned to read debts in breath-ledgers before she could read scripture. She is lean and sharp-eyed, her fingertips stained blue-green from the luminous pigments of the stained-glass windows. She wears a patched ledger-coat lined with sealed testimony vials. Hired as a clerk by House of the Tithe Lamp, she discovered discrepancies in the air accounts that suggest the bell's tides are failing.
characters.external_conflict: The Tithe Lamp's enforcers want her ledgers silenced while the Pale Mitre wants her as a pawn in the air-rights dispute.
characters.flaw: She trusts numbers over people and withholds information to keep control, which drives allies away.
characters.goal: Prove with glass testimony that the bell-tides are weakening and expose who has been hoarding air.
characters.internal_conflict: She is loyal to the House that raised her from poverty, yet her evidence suggests it built her family's ruin.
characters.motivation: To clear her dead father's crushing breath-debt, which the Tithe Lamp forged against his name, and to give her younger brother a life free of owing.
characters.name: Iselda Vane

abilities.description: Uses ritual precedent to trap rivals in binding legal and sacred obligations.
abilities.name: Oathbinding

abilities.description: Commands a web of hired agents who act where he cannot be seen.
abilities.name: Network of Proxies

characters.arc: His schemes tighten as the air thins, culminating in a choice between preserving the illusion of his line's legitimacy and sharing power; he ultimately clings to the illusion and is undone by his own recorded words.
characters.description: A silver-haired noble in his fifties and the speaker of the Court of the Pale Mitre, Corvin claims descent from the cathedral's last bishop. He moves slowly in heavy vestments the color of old bone, and his voice is soft enough that others lean in to hear it. He conducts audiences in the Choir of Glass, bathed in shifting light, and treats every oath as a weapon.
characters.external_conflict: He is locked in the Air Rights Dispute against the Tithe Lamp and must bypass the ban on violence in the nave through proxies and poison.
characters.flaw: Pride in ritual precedent blinds him to practical change and makes him unable to admit error.
characters.goal: Seize sovereign control of the city's air by forcing the Ringers to reveal the bell's secret and binding the Tithe Lamp with an oath-breaking scandal.
characters.internal_conflict: He privately suspects the Pale Mitre's oaths are hollow and that his ancestors were no saviors, but cannot bear to let the belief die.
characters.motivation: To preserve his line's sacred authority and prevent merchants from ever owning the air that his ancestors' oaths sanctified.
characters.name: Lord Corvin Halewick

abilities.description: Can feel the shifting of water and air pockets before the bell tolls.
abilities.name: Tide Sense

characters.arc: She moves from guarded keeper of secrets to reluctant truth-teller, finally entrusting Iselda with the knowledge she has held for decades.
characters.description: The aging Keeper-Ringer of the bell, Maera is a stooped woman with salt-white braids and rope-scarred hands. She lives in the Bellwell Crypt among tombs and black water, and has tolled the bell for forty years. She speaks rarely and sells silence to both sides, keeping her order's secrets close.
characters.external_conflict: Both the Tithe Lamp and the Pale Mitre court and coerce her, and her own order is divided over whether to confess.
characters.flaw: Secrecy has become a habit so deep that she lies even when honesty would save her.
characters.goal: Hide the weakening of the bell-tides until the Ringers can discover a way to restore them.
characters.internal_conflict: She fears that the bell tolls for something other than the Ringers, and that her life's devotion has been to a master she does not understand.
characters.motivation: To keep the city alive long enough to find out whether the bell answers the Ringers or something older.
characters.name: Maera Tollwright

abilities.description: Persuades and charms nearly anyone in the market.
abilities.name: Silver Tongue

characters.arc: Caught between masters, he begins as a double-dealing opportunist, then makes a costly choice to protect Iselda, sacrificing his advancement.
characters.description: A charming, sleepless broker in his thirties who works the Nave Concourse as a go-between for the Tithe Lamp, selling compressed air by the sealed flask. He wears a lamplit smile and a coat of brine-stained velvet, and keeps a pearl-lens monocle with which he appraises both goods and people.
characters.external_conflict: He is spying on Iselda for the Tithe Lamp while being quietly bribed by agents of the Pale Mitre.
characters.flaw: Greed and vanity make him easy to flatter and quick to betray.
characters.goal: Secure a seat among the Tithe Lamp's directors by delivering the Ringers' secret before anyone else.
characters.internal_conflict: He likes Iselda and feels guilt for watching her, but fears losing his only route to security.
characters.motivation: To buy his way into the House's inner circle and escape the fear of ever being short of breath.
characters.name: Dorian Pell

abilities.description: Navigates flooded passages and trench currents without light.
abilities.name: Skiff Piloting

characters.arc: She shifts from solitary survivor to open ally, risking her hidden community to carry the truth to the city.
characters.description: A smuggler and lapsed heretic in her thirties who hides in the Bellwell Crypt among the tombs, ferrying contraband air-salt in a small pressure-hulled skiff. She has a shaved scalp, a tattooed brine-knot on her throat, and a laugh that carries through stone.
characters.external_conflict: Enforcers from both powers hunt her for the contraband she moves and the secrets she hides.
characters.flaw: Distrust of all authority makes her reckless and hard to coordinate with.
characters.goal: Smuggle Iselda's evidence out of the Tithe Lamp's reach and reveal it through the glass guilds.
characters.internal_conflict: She wants to remain invisible, but the revelation of the truth would require stepping into the light.
characters.motivation: To keep the crypt's heretic community hidden and free from both the nobles' oaths and the merchants' debts.
characters.name: Sable Ondrey

relationships.description: Lord Corvin Halewick seeks to coerce or discredit Iselda Vane, whose ledgers could expose the bell's failing tides and upset his plan to claim sovereign control of the air.
Iselda Vane approaches Maera Tollwright for confirmation about the bell, and their wary alliance grows as Maera slowly shares what the Ringers know.
Dorian Pell befriends Iselda Vane while reporting on her to the Tithe Lamp, a bond that turns real and complicates his divided loyalties.
Lord Corvin Halewick pressures Maera Tollwright to reveal the bell's secret, while Maera stonewalls him and sells him only partial silence.
Sable Ondrey smuggles Iselda Vane's evidence through the crypt, an uneasy partnership driven by shared enemies and Sable's distrust of authority.
Lord Corvin Halewick bribes Dorian Pell through proxies to leak Tithe Lamp secrets, turning Dorian into a double agent against his own House.
